feedback:
Approved. The candidate is iteration 6 (the best raced design, 38.64) with one change: controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right. Evidence: iterations 0 to 6 never tested a fixed search direction. Slalom still shows line loss under last_direction (0.8 events per trial in iteration 6), and line loss was removed on oval and s-bend when the wide span was used (iteration 3 onward). max_error has stayed pinned at 0.060 to 0.065 across every change to kp, kd (0.05 to 0.30), ki, sensor size, span, speed and y, so the feedback loop is not the main lever and the line-loss recovery is the remaining untested variable. The candidate is valid and differs from the raced best by a single field, so a further revision round would cost two action runs without new evidence to justify a different value.

What to change after the race, depending on what it shows:
- If slalom line_loss_events falls toward 0 and max_error on slalom or s-bend drops to 0.06 or below, keep search_right and then step base_speed up (1.25, then 1.4) while watching max_error.
- If slalom line loss or max_error gets worse (the fixed direction turns the robot the wrong way), switch to search_left, the only other single-variable option.
- If max_error stays at about 0.061 on every track with either search direction, the loss-recovery direction is not the cause. Then the start transient or the motor mismatch is the likely source, so test a lower base_speed (about 0.9) with kd 0.3 rather than more gain changes.
requested_changes: Set controller.line_loss = search_right in place of last_direction, keeping iteration 6 otherwise unchanged (sensor y 0.05, wide span x = -0.07 to 0.07, base_speed 1.1, kp 2.0, ki 0.4, kd 0.3). Iteration 6 slalom still lost the line 0.8 times per trial under last_direction.
If slalom line_loss_events rises or max_error worsens with search_right, set controller.line_loss = search_left next, the only remaining untested direction.

If max_error stays near 0.061 with either search direction, lower controller.base_speed to about 0.9 with kd 0.3 unchanged, to test whether the start or bend-entry transient is driving the excursion (iterations 0 to 6 pinned max_error across all gain changes).
